threshold_method: Fixed absolute thresholds based on 20th and 70th percentiles of validation top-1 similarity distribution across the 5 training folds.
description: Validation testing showed that top-1 similarity has the highest Spearman correlation (0.397) with per-query P@10. The top1/top2 gap had negligible correlation (0.019). Therefore, the raw top-1 similarity is used as the most robust and transparent single indicator of reliability.
